text: The result compares the FY2027 NEP list with the House second-reading list. It is not the enacted budget.
A facility can have separate construction, equipment, and vehicle rows. Row counts are not unique-facility counts.
A House-only or NEP-only row can reflect a new line, removal, renaming, regrouping, or unmatched text.
The source reports that the NEP line sum is PHP 140,000 below its published annex control. This release uses the reconciled line sum.
The amounts are proposed budget authority, not allotment releases, obligations, payments, final costs, or completed facilities.
Recorded regional labels show document distribution. They do not measure population need, facility condition, or health outcomes.
Senate, bicameral, enacted GAA, release, procurement, payment, completion, and audit stages are not established here.
BetterGov performed the row extraction and initial matching. Busisi verifies saved bytes, schemas, row counts, arithmetic, and controls.
